answer: Sybil resistance binds each agent identity to a remotely attested TEE measurement, MRENCLAVE, signed by hardware-rooted keys. A verifier accepts the identity only when the enclave’s code and configuration match the authorized measurement, so copying credentials or launching a virtual machine cannot create another valid node. Cloning identities therefore requires purchasing additional physical silicon and attested hardware; sable, pearl, and spiral identifiers are useless without it.
